title: Centre-of-mass test of equal-and-opposite pair forces: masses 2.37 : 1.69 : 1 for A, B, C
pitch: Shape-free test of equal-and-opposite pair forces. Three particles at rest on a side-6 triangle, T = 2.5. If pair forces are central and equal-opposite, the mass-weighted centre of mass (m_A, m_B, m_C = 2.37, 1.69, 1, from K_BA/K_AB = 1.40, K_CA/K_AC = 2.37, K_CB/K_BC = 1.70) stays fixed. Prediction: drift below 0.01 (noise floor about 0.003). Equal masses predict drift about 0.14. Falsified if drift exceeds 0.01. Walls at least 0.7 away, pairs at least 5.5 apart: no wall or close approach.
